linear-function.why: The coordinate graphs were a fixed 400x400 px with no viewBox, so on phones (~300px) their edges were cut off. Let them scale to the screen.
linear-function.new: <svg width={SVG_W} height={SVG_H} viewBox={`0 0 ${SVG_W} ${SVG_H}`} style={{maxWidth:'100%',height:'auto'}} onClick={onClick} onMouseMove={onMouseMove}>

linear-function.why: Taps on a scaled graph must be converted back to graph units (factor is exactly 1 on computers, so nothing changes there).

equation-solver.why: Bug fix approved by Abed (2026-10-24): the 'solution steps' list saved the equation from BEFORE each action, so every row was one step behind. Save the equation AFTER the action. Math itself unchanged.
